topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out today that my friend has been weaving a careful lie about their job. It’s a curious thing, betrayal wrapped in something as mundane as daily work. I’ve known them long enough to see through the cracks, the moments when the facade slipped. It’s not the act itself that surprises me, but the effort. The weight of carrying such a silent burden, only to smile and share fabricated tales. I suppose we all paint our realities in hues that suit the moment. The truth is a leaky vessel, holding back the tides of what we wish to be. I will talk to them, not to confront, but to understand the landscape of their world, where honesty is a path less traveled.
